notes.title: The Wild Eight 1.0 Is Out Now! 15% Discount + Supporter Pack Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25176026/afccee1a7a184067808153e82aeb7ff527bc0a3f.gif[/img]

[h1]Greetings, everyone! 
[/h1]
Here’s a message from our partners at HypeTrain Digital - their top-selling survival title, The Wild Eight, is coming out of Early Access later today!

To celebrate, The Wild Eight 1.0 will be sold with a -15% discount for a week, until Oct 10th. 

DESOLATE owners will get an extra promotional offer -  an 30% off Coupon for The Wild Eight! 

Act now, while the offer lasts! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/526160/The_Wild_Eight/


[b]Here’s what’s awaits both new and old players in the The Wild Eight 1.0:
[/b]
[list]
[*] The conclusion to The Wild Eight's story - continue the main questline to uncover the mystery of the Dark Matter

[*] Discover new side-quests and locations in an all-new biome, filled with exciting creatures and resources

[*] Find and make use of the new ranged weapons and equipment;

[*] Stability improvements & optimization fixes 
[/list]

[h1]The Wild Eight Supporter Pack 
[/h1]
Want to give some extra love to the creators of The Wild Eight - and get some awesome stuff in return? We've got just the option! 

[i]The Wild Eight Supporter Pack is reserved for the biggest fans of The Wild Eight, and includes: 
[/i][list]
[*] The Wild Eight Digital Artbook 

[*] The WIld Eight Original Soundtrack 

[*] The Wild Eight Exclusive In-Game Content: Animal Hat Pack 

[/list]
[b]Message from the HypeTrain team!
[/b]
[i]We’d like to thank each and every one of our fans and Kickstarter backers - without them, this journey wouldn’t be possible! You helped us shape our game along every step of the way - providing valuable feedback on bugs and errors in Early Access, sharing your thoughts on the game’s balance and content, and just giving our team enough motivation for us to pull ourselves towards Version 1.0! 
[/i]

[i]It’s been a long, tough road - but it’s just a single step in the game’s history. The PS4 and Xbox One versions are currently in the works, and we’ll be able to share more info about them very soon. 
But after that -  what awaits The Wild Eight in the future? Only time will tell.
[/i]

notes.title: Step in to the next Level! STANDBY
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l3vRl7C542tWNrylG/source.gif[/img]

Dive in to a beautiful [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/494580]new platformer made by NoClip[/url]! This time you are challenged to get out of the glitched world breaking all the obstacles away.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3o6ZtrBGTJgVPqpp7O/source.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][h1]Slide, crush, dash and teleport through the levels![/h1]
You’ll never know what new mechanics will appear next!
[*][h1]54 Unique Levels![/h1]
Each will introduce you new mechanics on the go and will raise the bar for difficulty!
[*][h1]Precise controls![/h1]
 Because great platformers come from great character movement!
[*][h1]Glitchy beats![/h1]
They will follow you along the way ‘till your great escape!
[*][h1]Leaderboards![/h1]
So you can become the fastest out of all and brag about it!
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25176026/fa66bda6a08f4198678616051a2e25d77e48e4ff.jpg[/img]
